seo.title: About David Sandoval — Software Engineer
seo.description: Meet David Sandoval, a backend-oriented Software Engineer with hands-on frontend experience, project evidence, technical writing and ongoing research.

summary: I’m a backend-oriented Software Engineer with hands-on frontend experience. I care about understanding the domain, making technical decisions explicit and validating the behavior that matters.
biography: I’m a backend-oriented Software Engineer with meaningful frontend experience. I enjoy work where understanding the domain and tracing assumptions matters as much as choosing the implementation.

At Atena, I work on existing fintech software across backend and frontend boundaries. The work has taught me to look beyond the reported symptom: trace assumptions through affected consumers, check authorization and service boundaries, use type-system and static-analysis feedback to find impact, and validate fixes with targeted tests. When new evidence changes the diagnosis, I update the conclusion instead of defending the first explanation.

Outside work, I build and document engineering projects and continue undergraduate research. I’m currently validating a thesis direction around vulnerable-dependency remediation in open-source software; the research question and method are still being refined before I commit to a model.
availabilityStatement: Open to software engineering opportunities, including international remote roles, relocation and postgraduate paths.
researchSummary: I’m validating an undergraduate thesis direction on vulnerable-dependency remediation in open-source software, with the question and method still being refined through literature and data-feasibility work.
currentRoleSummary: I currently work at Atena as a Jr. Software Engineer. My work is backend-oriented with hands-on frontend delivery, with an emphasis on correctness, authorization, integration boundaries, debugging and validation in existing software.
